entities.summary: Chula Chakrabongse, was a member of the Chakri dynasty of Thailand and of the House of Chakkraphong. He was the only child of Prince Chakrabongse Bhuvanath and his Ukrainian wife Kateryna Desnytska. He was a grandson of King Chulalongkorn.
